text:
Predicates:
Feud(x, y) ::: x has a feud with y.
Includes(x, y) ::: x includes y.
Leads(x, y) ::: x leads y.
Member(x, y) ::: x is a member of y.
Stable(x) ::: x is a professional wrestling stable.

Premises:
DiamondMine(wwe) ∧ Leads(RoderickStrong, DiamondMine) ∧ Includes(DiamondMine, CreedBrothers) ∧ Includes(DiamondMine, IvyNile) ∧ Feud(Imperium, DiamondMine) ::: Diamond Mine is a WWE stable led by Roderick Strong and includes the Creed Brothers and Ivy Nile, and Imperium has a feud with Diamond Mine.

Conclusion:
¬Feud(Imperium, IvyNile) ::: Imperium doesn't have a feud with a professional wrestling stable that includes Ivy Nile.
